component.name: Denon Remote
component.summary: Control a Denon or Marantz network receiver

description.p: A desktop remote control for Denon and Marantz network receivers. The window follows changes made on the front panel, the infrared remote or the HEOS app.

ul.li: Power, volume in decibels, mute and input selection for the main zone, zone 2 and zone 3
Surround modes and Quick Select presets
Bass, treble and subwoofer trim, dynamic range, Restorer, ECO and the sleep timer
Cursor control for the on-screen setup menu
Receiver discovery on the local network, and a tray icon for power, mute and volume
